sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL entry APR-009 still reads 'approved' with no end date. But 8D-26-009 revoked the HB-620 approval on 2026-09-15, which is after the 2026-09-01 meeting and before today (2026-11-14). The newer 8D therefore overrides the ASL, so Fonderia Dora has no current approval for HB-620 at Pinerolo for Nordhavn. Continuing to order is not allowed. The ASL record should be updated.

sources.quote: porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings (AlSi9Cu3), three escapes to the Nordhavn line

findings.why: Fonderia Dora has an open 8D on the AlSi9Cu3 castings for HB-620, the same material and part as the proposed orders. It is still open and the root cause is only stated as die temperature control.

sources.quote: SC-HB620-POR,HB-620,Porosity grade 2 or better in mount bores,
porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings

findings.why: The measured porosity in the mount bores is grade 4. The special characteristic in the control plan requires grade 2 or better, so the measured value fails it. Three of these castings reached the Nordhavn line.
